reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is largely consistent with established size-dependent melting and element-specific diffusion effects, though it relies heavily on the accuracy of the chosen EAM potential.

reasons.usefulness: It offers specific mechanistic insights into elemental diffusion and melting behavior that are directly relevant to designing and optimizing high-entropy nanoparticles for high-temperature applications.
